rows.headline: Promoter Indo Borax pledges its entire 64% stake
rows.summary: Indo Borax pledged all 2.38 crore Kronox shares it holds as added security for a roughly ₹225 crore loan taken to buy the stake; it says ownership and control are unchanged.

rows.headline: Silver hits a one-year low on Fed rate-rise bets
rows.summary: MCX silver fell more than 3% on Monday as markets priced a high chance of a December US rate rise; gold also slipped to multi-month lows.

rows.headline: September-quarter profit falls 95%
rows.summary: Net profit dropped to ₹5.9 crore from ₹128.5 crore a year earlier and income slipped 3% to ₹1,091 crore; higher depreciation and finance costs squeezed earnings.

rows.headline: First results as a listed company: profit down 9% on the quarter
rows.summary: Revenue rose 1.6% from the June quarter to ₹154 crore, but operating profit fell 13% and net profit 9% to ₹17.4 crore.
